scenes.title: Better, Worse, or Like Us
scenes.summary: People in action are better than we are, worse, or like us, as the painters Polygnotus, Pauson and Dionysius portrayed them.

scenes.title: In Every Art
scenes.summary: The same differences appear in dancing and music, in prose and verse: Homer imitates better people, Cleophon people like us, Hegemon of Thasos and Nicochares worse; so too in dithyramb and nome, as in the Cyclopes of Timotheus and Philoxenus.

scenes.title: Tragedy and Comedy
scenes.summary: This is the difference between tragedy and comedy: comedy imitates people worse than those of today, tragedy better.
